notices.body:
Updated: Tuesday, November 17, 2026

Terminal Project Work - Berth Closure and Alternate Service Crofton (Vancouver Island) and Vesuvius Bay (Salt Spring Island) September 2026 to Summer 2027

Life extension work continues at Crofton terminal, with construction expected to be completed by summer 2027. These important upgrades will support safe and reliable service and prepare the terminal for the anticipated introduction of two-ship service in 2027.

Evening Sailing Cancellations (October 18 – December 10, 2026)

To support critical construction activities and provide longer work windows for crews, the last round-trip sailing between Crofton and Vesuvius Bay has been cancelled Sunday through Thursday until December 10.

Cancelled Sailings October 18 - December 10 (Sunday through Thursday):

9:30 pm departing Vesuvius Bay

10:00 pm departing Crofton

A passenger-only water taxi is operating in place of these cancelled sailings. Please note, the temporary water-taxi boarding locations are not fully accessible and may present challenges for customers with mobility limitations.

Planned Berth Closure (January 17 – 23, 2027)

A seven-day temporary berth closure is required from January 17 – 23, 2027, to support key construction milestones. During this closure, alternate transportation options will be available for foot passengers and customers travelling with vehicles.

Foot Passenger Water Taxi A foot passenger water taxi will operate between Crofton and Vesuvius, following the route’s regular ferry schedule, with an additional round trip on Sundays.

Service will operate…

notices.title: Temporary Vessel Replacement and Revised Departure Time - October 24 - December 11, 2026
notices.body:
Temporary Vessel Replacement and Revised Departure Time Swartz Bay (Victoria) – Fulford Harbour (Salt Spring Island) October 24 – December 11, 2026

The Queen of Cumberland will provide service on our Swartz Bay – Fulford Harbour route October 24 - December 11, 2026, while the Skeena Queen undergoes its scheduled refit.

To accommodate vessel fueling operations, the 9:00 pm Wednesday evening sailing from Swartz Bay will depart 15 minutes later than scheduled, at 9:15 pm on the noted dates. • October: 28 • November: 4, 11, 18 and 25 • December: 2 and 9

Passenger amenities on board the Queen of Cumberland include the Coast Café Express, a designated pet area, workstations, and a children's play area.

Thank you for your patience and our apologies for any inconvenience experienced as a result of this schedule adjustment.

For up-to-date sailing and departure information, check Current Conditions, follow @BCFerries on X or phone 1-888-223-3779 for further assistance.

notices.title: Lane Closures for Inspection and Repairs - Fulford Harbour Terminal - November 16-20, 2026
notices.body:
Lane Closures for Inspection and Repairs Fulford Harbour (Salt Spring Island) Terminal November 16–20, 2026

To support safe and reliable service, repairs to a section of the timber structure beneath the holding compound at Fulford Harbour terminal will take place from November 16-20, 2026.

Crews will remove sections of asphalt and the underlying decking between lanes 8–11 to allow for inspection and subsequent repairs.

Lanes 8–11 will be temporarily closed, and customers are asked to follow the directions of staff, signage, and traffic control personnel, as vehicle line-ups are expected on Fulford-Ganges Road.

Work will take place during daytime hours, starting at 8 am. Noise due to jackhammering and asphalt removal is expected on Monday, November 16, and may continue into Friday, November 20. Minimal noise is anticipated for the remainder of the work, while the inspection and repairs take place.

Updates will be shared through Service Notices if there are any impacts to operations.

Thank you to our customers and neighbours for your patience and understanding as we complete these necessary repairs.

For up-to-date sailing and departure information, check Current Conditions, follow @BCFerries on X, or phone 1-888-223-3779 for further assistance.

Updated: Friday, October 30, 2026

Terminal Upgrades – Berth Closure and Alternate Service Otter Bay (Pender Island) December 2025 to Fall 2026

Life extension work continues at Otter Bay Terminal and is expected to be completed by the end of 2026.

Planned Berth Closure

To complete the remaining work, a full berth closure at Otter Bay Terminal will be required. As a result, all regular ferry service to and from Pender Island will be suspended from November 20 - 24, 2026. Emergency and essential services will not be impacted, and Dangerous Goods (DG) sailings will be revised to accommodate the closure and updated online. BC Ferries will work with commercial users to minimize disruptions.

During the Berth Closure

A foot-passenger water-taxi service will operate between Otter Bay Marina on Pender Island and the Terminal Maintenance Float, adjacent to Berth 1 (in front of the ticket booth area) at Swartz Bay terminal.

Tickets can be purchased at the Swartz Bay foot passenger ticket booth.

Landing areas waiting rooms will be heated and have access to washrooms.

Terminal staff will be on site to assist customers and provide directions to the loading area.

Customers will be able to transport items such as bicycles, strollers, and mobility aids.

Free parking will be available at both terminals.

There will be a complimentary shuttle service between the Otter Bay Marina and Otter Bay terminal (approx. 300 metres).

Pets are welcome on the water-taxi and shuttle, subject to each operator’s pet policy.

A detailed Alternate Service Guide is available for download on the…

Temporary Vessel Replacement and Revised Departure Time Swartz Bay (Victoria) – Fulford Harbour (Salt Spring Island) October 24 – December 11, 2026

The Queen of Cumberland will provide service on our Swartz Bay – Fulford Harbour route October 24 - December 11, 2026, while the Skeena Queen undergoes its scheduled refit.

To accommodate vessel fueling operations, the 9:00 pm Wednesday evening sailing from Swartz Bay will depart 15 minutes later than scheduled, at 9:15 pm on the noted dates. • October: 28 • November: 4, 11, 18 and 25 • December: 2 and 9

Passenger amenities on board the Queen of Cumberland include the Coast Café Express, a designated pet area, workstations, and a children's play area.

Thank you for your patience and our apologies for any inconvenience experienced as a result of this schedule adjustment.

For up-to-date sailing and departure information, check Current Conditions, follow @BCFerries on X or phone 1-888-223-3779 for further assistance.

notices.title: Lane Closures for Inspection and Repairs - Fulford Harbour Terminal - November 16-20, 2026
notices.body:
Lane Closures for Inspection and Repairs Fulford Harbour (Salt Spring Island) Terminal November 16–20, 2026

To support safe and reliable service, repairs to a section of the timber structure beneath the holding compound at Fulford Harbour terminal will take place from November 16-20, 2026.

Crews will remove sections of asphalt and the underlying decking between lanes 8–11 to allow for inspection and subsequent repairs.

Lanes 8–11 will be temporarily closed, and customers are asked to follow the directions of staff, signage, and traffic control personnel, as vehicle line-ups are expected on Fulford-Ganges Road.

Work will take place during daytime hours, starting at 8 am. Noise due to jackhammering and asphalt removal is expected on Monday, November 16, and may continue into Friday, November 20. Minimal noise is anticipated for the remainder of the work, while the inspection and repairs take place.

Updates will be shared through Service Notices if there are any impacts to operations.

Thank you to our customers and neighbours for your patience and understanding as we complete these necessary repairs.

For up-to-date sailing and departure information, check Current Conditions, follow @BCFerries on X, or phone 1-888-223-3779 for further assistance.

Updated: Friday, October 30, 2026

Terminal Upgrades – Berth Closure and Alternate Service Otter Bay (Pender Island) December 2025 to Fall 2026

Life extension work continues at Otter Bay Terminal and is expected to be completed by the end of 2026.

Planned Berth Closure

To complete the remaining work, a full berth closure at Otter Bay Terminal will be required. As a result, all regular ferry service to and from Pender Island will be suspended from November 20 - 24, 2026. Emergency and essential services will not be impacted, and Dangerous Goods (DG) sailings will be revised to accommodate the closure and updated online. BC Ferries will work with commercial users to minimize disruptions.

During the Berth Closure

A foot-passenger water-taxi service will operate between Otter Bay Marina on Pender Island and the Terminal Maintenance Float, adjacent to Berth 1 (in front of the ticket booth area) at Swartz Bay terminal.

Tickets can be purchased at the Swartz Bay foot passenger ticket booth.

Landing areas waiting rooms will be heated and have access to washrooms.

Terminal staff will be on site to assist customers and provide directions to the loading area.

Customers will be able to transport items such as bicycles, strollers, and mobility aids.

Free parking will be available at both terminals.

There will be a complimentary shuttle service between the Otter Bay Marina and Otter Bay terminal (approx. 300 metres).

Pets are welcome on the water-taxi and shuttle, subject to each operator’s pet policy.

Updated: Tuesday, November 17, 2026

Terminal Project Work - Berth Closure and Alternate Service Crofton (Vancouver Island) and Vesuvius Bay (Salt Spring Island) September 2026 to Summer 2027

Life extension work continues at Crofton terminal, with construction expected to be completed by summer 2027. These important upgrades will support safe and reliable service and prepare the terminal for the anticipated introduction of two-ship service in 2027.

Evening Sailing Cancellations (October 18 – December 10, 2026)

To support critical construction activities and provide longer work windows for crews, the last round-trip sailing between Crofton and Vesuvius Bay has been cancelled Sunday through Thursday until December 10.

Cancelled Sailings October 18 - December 10 (Sunday through Thursday):

9:30 pm departing Vesuvius Bay

10:00 pm departing Crofton

A passenger-only water taxi is operating in place of these cancelled sailings. Please note, the temporary water-taxi boarding locations are not fully accessible and may present challenges for customers with mobility limitations.

Planned Berth Closure (January 17 – 23, 2027)

A seven-day temporary berth closure is required from January 17 – 23, 2027, to support key construction milestones. During this closure, alternate transportation options will be available for foot passengers and customers travelling with vehicles.

Foot Passenger Water Taxi A foot passenger water taxi will operate between Crofton and Vesuvius, following the route’s regular ferry schedule, with an additional round trip on Sundays.
